Skills for Industry Competitiveness and Innovation Program (SICIP)

QA visit: documents to keep ready at the institute

For the Principal / Centre Manager
Based on the QA Visit Report (Annex-3)
Name of TI/TC
Visit date(s)
Checked by (name, signature)

Keep every document below in one place, filed by course and batch, before the QA team arrives. Tick each one when it is ready. Where a document does not apply to your centre, write "N/A" beside it. The visiting officer checks each one and records it as seen, not seen or not applicable.

1Registration and contractReport 1

  • Registration or accreditation certificate (BTEB / NSDA / other); trade licence or NGO registration
  • Constitution or statement of mission, vision and objectives; organogram
  • Signed SICIP contract / MoU and Business Plan (courses, targets, duration, amount)
  • Contracts / MoUs with other organisations or projects for skills training, if any

2Quality managementReport 2

  • Written quality management procedure or work-flow chart
  • PIU / SDCMU capacity assessment reports
  • Self-assessment team formation order and self-appraisal reports
  • Feedback and improvement plan
  • Visit log / monitoring register, with action taken on findings of earlier visits

3Budget and financeReport 3

  • Periodic budget by trainee target, expenditure plan and batch-wise resource requirements
  • Purchase documents (bills, vouchers) for teaching and training materials
  • Stock register, daily consumption register and fuel consumption register
  • Statements of the separate SICIP bank account
  • Bill register, cash book, ledgers, vouchers and fixed asset register
  • Stipend disbursement records, Statement of Expenditure (SOE) and trainer salary bank payment records

4Selection and enrolmentReport 4

  • Advertisement or flyer (objectives, outputs, schedule) and proof of the media used
  • Selection criteria, list of applicants and participant list of selection tests
  • Aptitude test and interview results summary; admission test procedure
  • Final list of trainees and waiting list
  • Admission form with supporting documents for every trainee
  • Trainee list by gender, indigenous / ethnic, disadvantaged and special-needs groups
  • Course-wise list of trainees' entry qualification and experience
  • Written complaint procedure for rejected applicants
  • Enrolment and attendance of every trainee up to date in TMS

5Attendance and dropoutsReport 1.60–1.62

  • Attendance register of every running batch, up to date
  • Dropout register with reasons and the steps taken to reduce dropouts

6Job placementReport 5

  • Job placement unit and employers' committee: formation order, member list, officer's appointment letter, meeting notices and minutes
  • Job profiles, vacancy list and list of prospective employers
  • Industry visit register and register of industry contacts by phone
  • Trainee CVs; intern trainee, counselling and job fair records
  • Placement register since the start of SICIP (matching TMS)
  • Appointment letters or employer statements; 3-month job tracking records

7Standards and learning materialsReport 6

  • Competency standards (CS) or course outlines for every SICIP course
  • CBLM, lesson plans and training delivery plan (TDP) with the assessment schedule
  • Job sheets, specification sheets and information sheets
  • Assessment tools: demonstration, observation and question checklists

8TrainersReport 7

  • List of trainers (including guest trainers) with qualifications, teaching and industry experience, and training received
  • Recruitment records: advertisement, selection criteria and selection documents
  • Trainer capacity development plan and yearly appraisal records

9Physical resources and safetyReport 8, 8.1

  • Layout of classrooms and workshops with sizes and utilities (electricity, water, gas, compressed air)
  • List of tools and equipment required by the CS and list of those available
  • List of available PPE; lists of consumables purchased and used per course
  • Preventive maintenance schedule, maintenance register and replacement records
  • Fire extinguishers with last inspection date; first aid kit

10Training delivery and assessmentReport 9, 10

  • Industry logbook (industry-based centres and internships)
  • Assessment guide; written assessment, appeal and reassessment procedures
  • Formative assessment results and summative assessment records
  • Course-wise list of accredited assessors
  • Certification records and certificate issue register, by course and batch

+Figures to have ready

For each SICIP course: target, number of batches and batch size; enrolled, certified, job-placed and dropouts to date (total and female); and for each running batch: batch no., start and end date, enrolled, female, today's attendance, 7-day average attendance and TMS mismatches.

+On display and present on the day

Safety and PPE symbols in classrooms and workshops. The Principal / Centre Manager, trainers of running batches, the job placement officer and the accounts person should be available.
